question: ‘Vikramarjuna - Vijaya’ composed by Pampa was written in which of the following languages?
solution:
The correct answer is **Kannada**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The annals of **Kannada literature** are incomplete without the mention of **Adikavi Pampa**, a revered **poet of the 10th century**.
 
• Known as the first poet of the language, Pampa's works were primarily in Kannada, and he was a firm believer in **Jainism**.
 
• His two epic works, **Vikramarjuna Vijaya or Pampa Bharata and the Adi Purana**, written around **939 CE**, were composed in the champu style and served as court poems for the **Vemulavada Chalukyan king Arikesari II**.
 
• Pampa also held a position as a feudatory under the **Rashtrakuta dynasty king Krishna III**.
 
• His works set the foundation for all subsequent Kannada champu compositions and marked a significant beginning for the **10th century in Kannada literature**, alongside the works of two other **Jain authors, Sri Ponna and Ranna**, collectively known as the **“Three gems of Kannada literature”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kannada first female poet**

 
 
• **Akka Mahadevi** (circa 1130 – 1160) emerged as a significant figure in** 12th-century Kannada literature **and played a prominent role within the **Lingayat Shaiva sect**.
 
• She is renowned as one of the **pioneering female poets of this era**.
 
 
 
• **Adikavi** (adi ‘primaeval, first’ + kavi ‘poet’) means **‘the first poet**’.
